purpose: Local contract for memory-first sales process records. It extends the Enterprise Context model without changing the global ontology for every domain.

entity_classes.meaning: A branch of a business process with a materially different control, document, stock, legal-entity, supply, or billing behavior.
A cross-cutting capability that modifies or enriches a process but is not a standalone end-to-end process.
A controlled place where fields, logic, integration, copy/reference behavior, or side-by-side capability may extend the standard process.

memory_code_contract.stability_rule: Author mnemonic codes are stable learning identifiers. SAP scope-item IDs are maintained as external references.
